study: Post hoc diagnostic on all 14 previously inspected PMLB tasks and their 42 archived outer folds. The following comparison is fixed locally before computing any new candidate-level outer refits.
question: Does a veto from a frozen full predictor anticipate an observed loss after refitting on the deployment support S alone, compared with refitting on anchor A alone?
candidates: In each fold take up to 12 unique nonempty strict subsets uniformly without replacement from the sorted union of supports proposed along the archived point, nested and separating paths (seed 117034 + 10*dataset ordinal + fold). Also draw up to four distinct uniform deletion masks for each of the distinct deletion sizes 1, ceil(k/4), floor(k/2) strictly between 0 and k (seed 47113 + 10*dataset ordinal + fold). Score the two populations separately even where they overlap. No test label or outcome is used to choose a support. One-column anchors generate zero proposals.
rules: Fixed 4 ranking-row panels. Shared anchor, learner, proposal, cache and metric thresholds. Compare point-only at empty, four-panel empty, endpoints, nested, separating, size-matched random (original draw), pooled votes over the separating family, and one-panel minimum over that same family. Audit all ballots without short-circuiting.
target: Refit one common CPU histogram XGBoost (100 boosting rounds, depth 4) on all outer development rows of A and each S. Estimate the loss on the archived external test rows with no restored tail. A failure is a drop greater than 3 percent of anchor AUC or accuracy, or 5 percent of anchor average precision for the ranking-design rare-positive case, plus numerical tolerance 1e-12. This finite-fold outcome is not population truth. Save continuous differences and probabilities.
analysis: For each source, report TP FP FN TN against the refit outcome and task-stratified counts, including empty tasks. Incremental detections and false alarms relative to endpoints, and pairwise differences versus budget-matched random and pooled. Fold/proposal correlation precludes treating the candidate count as independent. No significance or generalization claim. No thresholds will be tuned using these outcomes.
limits: One thread in each learner and one hour per fold; persist selection before outer evaluation, verify anchor predictions match archive and source package digests. Local replication, no public preregistration.
